releaseNotes.en: Added Manager shortcuts for Camera, Gallery, App Store, and File Explorer. Expanded the App Store with more developer, global, and China-friendly apps. Installed Apps now detects available updates, App Store loading is faster and smoother, and Manager icons have been revamped throughout.
releaseNotes.zh: 新增相机、图库、应用商店和文件管理器快捷方式；扩充应用商店，加入更多开发者、全球及中国区友好应用；“已安装应用”现可检测可用更新，应用商店加载更快速流畅，并全面升级管理器图标。
